region.name: Reedwater Delta
region.description: Wetlands, fishing villages, and occupied river docks.

locations.name: Otter’s Crossing
locations.description: Friendly resistance settlement: merchant, healing, upgrades, and mission board.

locations.name: Reedlight Refuge
locations.description: A peaceful refuge with a friendly quest scout and an upgrade forge.

locations.name: Otter’s Crossing Forge
locations.description: Upgrade firearms and protective outfits at the resistance forge.

locations.name: Harbormaster Reed

npc.name: Harbormaster Reed
dialogue: Welcome, resistance fighter. You are safe here. Let us plan our next move.
Admiral Miretooth holds Reedwater Delta. Our scouts have marked the installations on your map.
I have courier escorts, defensive patrols, named officer assignments, and commander bounties. Choose a mission to see its first step and a map marker.
Speak to me for missions, visit the merchant for supplies, and use the forge to strengthen your gun and armour.
Wetlands, fishing villages, and occupied river docks.

local: Wetlands, fishing villages, and occupied river docks.
The bounty center lists every major boss and the sector where they hide.
advice: Early orchard camps hold small patrols. Watch their tells and pick your approach.
Berlin opens after all eight commanders fall. Adolph Whisker is the final target.

locations.name: Doctor Willow

npc.name: Doctor Willow
dialogue: Three fishing lanterns failed to return. Take medkits; the marsh gas hurts lungs long after the gunfire stops.
The delta is a family of little boats. If one is missing, we all feel the empty place.
I have one personal request: Lanterns in the Fog. Ask about my work when you are ready.

local: The delta is a family of little boats. If one is missing, we all feel the empty place.

locations.name: Lockkeeper Ripple

npc.name: Lockkeeper Ripple
dialogue: Two valves, then the big wheel. Open them in that order and the river will breathe again.
My grandfather taught me every bend in this water. I still talk to him when the fog comes in.
I have one personal request: The River Remembers. Ask about my work when you are ready.

locations.name: Otter’s Crossing Bounty Center

posters.name: Colonel Ironwhisker
attackHints: Sidestep the marked charge line, then punish the recovery.
Rifle fans and marked artillery alternate with a ground slam.
In the third phase the charge chains into a return charge.

posters.name: Major Bramble
attackHints: Bramble leaps to a new firing position and marks delayed sniper shots.
Artillery lanes are backed by summoned scouts and wire hunters.
Watch for a teleport followed by a spreading rifle fan.

posters.name: General Flintfang
attackHints: Move out of the marked ground slam before Flintfang lands.
Seismic rings expand around the battery; leave a clear path between marks.
Full-circle bullets alternate with a line of delayed shells.

posters.name: Marshal Whiteclaw
attackHints: Find gaps in the full-circle ice fan while Whiteclaw skates aside.
Marked frost patches become slowing ground.
An aimed slam is followed by a narrower ice fan.

posters.name: Field Marshal Sirocco
attackHints: Dodge across the charge direction and keep clear of the marked sand strikes.
A rocket fan covers Sirocco’s sideways skate.
The final phase adds a leap to the surrounding artillery pattern.

posters.name: Admiral Miretooth
attackHints: Leave marked poison circles before Miretooth leaps toward you.
A line of venom patches is backed by spreading rifle fire.
A teleport to the floodgate is followed by reinforcements.

posters.name: Director Geargnash
attackHints: Geargnash shields up, deploys a turret and marks the ground around you.
The furnace slam leaves burning zones on both sides.
Rocket fans alternate with engineer or signal-jammer reinforcements.

posters.name: Supreme Commander Vex
attackHints: Full-circle bullet rings cover Vex’s leap to a new position.
Delayed artillery crosses your route with an ice fan.
The final phase adds seismic rings and skirmisher reinforcements.

posters.name: Adolph Whisker
attackHints: Phase I · Tyrant’s Arsenal: teleport rings, marked artillery and rocket fans.
Phase II · Blink Assault: a wider arsenal joins the teleport and delayed strike combinations.
Phase III · Berlin Lockdown: lingering hazards, summoned elites and orbital strikes.
Phase IV · Last Whisker: chained teleports weave every attack together. Save dodge and healing for this phase.

locations.name: Pilgrim Sora

npc.name: Pilgrim Sora
dialogue: Follow the wind bells northeast of Reedlight Refuge to Pilgrim Sora.

Ring the three terrace bells in any order, then awaken the sanctuary in the middle of the loop. Defeat the guardian, recover its expedition seal, then return to Pilgrim Sora. REWARD: Galeweave Mantle — reload for speed and an empowered shot — plus Aurora Well, a healing sanctuary.
